scope: C274 Astra Standard14, CLI 0.153.3, 14 cases x N=5, same-day measured conditions

recommendation.confidence: within measured workload; small low-medium difference; not a general Astra ranking
recommendation.criteria: Preserve observed quality; prefer lower elapsed time when token differences are small; retain token-first high alternative. This is a post-measurement operational judgement, not a preregistered gate.

caveats: per-case N=5; score ceiling; no proof of equal latent quality
sequential unrandomized campaigns; time confounded with execution period
all-agent tokens are not billed monetary cost
CLI interval is not pure inference; formal work duration unavailable

quality_interpretation.fixed_grader_predicate: daily literal in normalized terminal response
quality_interpretation.interpretation: 3 responses ask for default mode and strict fallback policy, but omit explicit daily choice; fixed scores preserved; not evidence of unauthorized implementation

representative_traces.finding: low separated start, instructions and listing, source bodies, final status into four exec calls; high combined instructions and source bodies into one call and used three exec calls
same required focused pytest and main_verify once each; xhigh and max validation wrapper requested yield_time_ms 1000 and used a separate outer wait
max examples: absent run_sh test patterns or zero unittest discovery required reselection; instructions and source reads were also split before edit in iterations 2 and 4

method.decomposition: 70-run sums; descriptive mean is sum divided by 5; original KPI medians unchanged
method.identity: total = cached input + (input minus cached input) + reasoning output + (output minus reasoning output)
method.evidence: all 350 runs: summed token_usage_record agrees with final session usage and registered total
method.limitations: counter decomposition is exact; inner decision cause and dollar costs are not inferred
